verification.stimulus: Independently introduce each malformed, reversed, unknown, duplicate, reordered, empty-mixed, complete-mixed, or relationship-divergent graph.
verification.expectedSemanticState: Every invalid graph fails closed with a typed domain error before products exist.
verification.expectedEvidenceState: The test runner reports every literal graph-rejection vector.
verification.forbiddenMutation: No invalid binding or Question constraint is admitted.
